paragraphs.text: The Nether Void is a white, featureless location where spellcasting is suppressed. During the Summit of the Null Moon , Leshrac initiated a fight with Kristina of the Woods and Taysir . Faralyn then sent all three of them to the Nether Void.
The Nether Void is described as "some sort of pocket dimension", implying it may be a pocket plane .

Ice Age 's Ghostly Flame refers to a "nether world", and Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering refers to a dwarven afterlife in the "Nether Realms", but the nature of these locations and their relation to the Nether Void is unknown.
